Battleaxe coating · Phase1 candidate review

Unapproved isolated candidates. No usable items, IDs or gameplay values installed.

15 base/candidate inventory pairs at native48×32 and nearest4×. Metal interior, handle, canvas and alpha retained; teal edits affect existing blade-edge pixels only. These are static archive-derived previews, not screenshots from the game.

Dose concepts

Authentic poison52 shape; proposed teal liquid bands. Skull/readability and fill-level treatment require owner review.

Limits

  • Static native pixel approximation using current legacy grayscale tint. Not production renderer captures.
  • White/grey retain existing black held palette mismatch.
  • No equipped composites, camera projection or layered hand occlusion acceptance.
  • Mirrored frames are geometric previews, not proof of all direction routing.
  • No gameplay code/items/IDs/default balance installed.

Reproduce: python3 scripts/audit-battleaxe-coatings.py — outputs in output/battleaxe-coatings-review. Coverage JSON records source and output SHA256 fingerprints.
